claims.text: Ilak is interested in senior and staff-level software engineering roles with meaningful technical ownership, especially where AI systems, distributed backends, or product-minded engineering intersect. She is also open to technical founder associate or founding engineer conversations when there is strong mission and engineering culture fit.

Ilak has built and shipped backend services, full-stack web applications, data-intensive pipelines, and ML-adjacent systems across design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.

Her strongest areas include backend engineering (APIs, services, databases), distributed systems concepts, cloud-native deployment, and pragmatic AI/ML systems integration. She is comfortable across TypeScript, Python, and Go ecosystems.
Ilak has experience integrating models into production workflows, building evaluation-minded features, and designing systems where ML components must be reliable, observable, and cost-aware.
She has used AWS as a primary cloud, along with managed data and messaging services, containers, and infrastructure-as-code patterns. She can ramp on GCP or Azure where teams standardize on them.
Ilak is open to full-time roles and startup roles when the problem space is compelling, the team values craft and velocity, and compensation and runway expectations are transparent.
